# Fred Krieger Fabrics

> > Fred Krieger Fabrics specializes in flame-retardant theatrical fabrics, stage curtains, and event drapery including velour, bengaline, and lining materials for theaters, churches, and special events.

Fred Krieger Fabrics is a textile converter offering NFPA-701 certified flame-retardant fabrics for theatrical productions, houses of worship, and event venues. Their product line features premium velour fabrics from Milliken Textiles (Encore, Prism), proprietary velours (Memorable, Princess, Plateau, Carmel, Crescent), decorative event fabrics (Bengaline, Shantung, Nassau Chevron), and specialty linings (Cyc Cloth, Denim, Ranger Cloth).

## Key Topics

- Flame-retardant fabrics (IFR/FR)
- NFPA-701 certification
- Theatrical velour fabrics
- Stage curtains and drapes
- Encore Velour by Milliken
- Prism Velour
- Bengaline event fabrics
- Theater curtain linings (Cyc Cloth, Denim, Ranger Cloth)
- Event and wedding drapery
- Church and worship fabrics
- Pipe and drape systems
- Cotton and polyester theatrical materials
- Sample cards and fabric swatches
- Stage drapery fabrication
- Decorative event textiles
